transcript: Finally got around to setting up prox mox on the old server in the closet, took way longer than it should have because of some networking issue. Once that was sorted I got graf ana up and running to actually see the metrics, which felt really satisfying. Theo talked me through the trickiest part over a call, couldn't have finished it tonight without him.
